en_title: 'Horror Is Always at Its Strongest When Something Bad Is Happening to the World' – Boss of Silent Hill Remake Dev Bloober Reveals the Secret to His Studio's Success
cn_title: 「当世界遭遇不幸时，恐怖题材总是最强盛」——《寂静岭》重制版开发商Bloober负责人揭示工作室成功的秘诀
opus_summary: Bloober Team首席执行官Piotr Babieno认为，世界发生坏事时，恐怖题材往往最强势。他表示，工作室专注于恐怖游戏创作，并从玩家反馈中改进。《寂静岭2》重制版销量已超过500万份，工作室目前有七款恐怖游戏处于不同开发阶段。

paragraphs.en: Bloober Team certainly appears to be the busiest horror studio in the business right now. Off the back of its 2024 Silent Hill 2 remake selling over 5 million copies, the Polish developer currently has a staggering seven horror games in various stages of production. During Gamescom Asia x Thailand Game Show in Bangkok last week, IGN sat down with Bloober Team CEO Piotr Babieno to get an insight into the secrets to his studio’s success, its ambitious plans for the future, and why horror has become such a bankable genre in recent years.
paragraphs.cn: Bloober Team眼下看起来无疑是业内最忙碌的恐怖游戏工作室。在2024年推出的《寂静岭2》重制版销量突破500万份之后，这家波兰开发商目前有多达七款恐怖游戏处于不同的制作阶段。上周，在曼谷举行的Gamescom Asia x Thailand Game Show期间，IGN与Bloober Team首席执行官Piotr Babieno坐下来聊了聊，以了解他的工作室成功的秘诀、其雄心勃勃的未来计划，以及恐怖题材为何在近年来变得如此有利可图。

paragraphs.en: “I would say that horror is always at its strongest when something bad is happening to the world,” said Babieno. “When we have climate changes, when we have wars, [or] when we have some economical issues in the world. This is the moment when society [has] some kind of fear inside.”
paragraphs.cn: Babieno说：「我认为，当世界遭遇不幸时，恐怖题材总是最强盛的。当我们面临气候变化、战争，或者世界出现某些经济问题时，就是社会内心产生某种恐惧的时候。」

paragraphs.en: “That’s why horror movies, horror novels, and horror games are working so well," he continued. "It’s working for horror, but I’m not happy about it because it always means that the world is not in good shape.”
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「这就是恐怖电影、恐怖小说和恐怖游戏如此成功的原因。这对恐怖题材有利，但我对此并不高兴，因为这总是意味着世界的状况不佳。」

paragraphs.en: Babieno is obviously not wrong. Humanity is currently faced with a global cost of living crisis, increasingly volatile weather events, ongoing wars between Russia and Ukraine and the U.S. and Iran, and the existential threat posed by the rapidly accelerating adoption of AI across virtually every major industry.
paragraphs.cn: Babieno显然没有说错。人类目前面临着全球生活成本危机、愈发反复无常的天气事件、俄罗斯与乌克兰以及美国与伊朗之间持续的战争，还有几乎所有主要行业都在迅速加快采用AI所带来的生存威胁。

paragraphs.en: At the same time, the horror genre has rarely been hotter across most entertainment mediums. Indie horror films Backrooms and Obsession became major success stories at the box office earlier this year, with the latter going on to make over half a billion dollars. The Resident Evil series continues to be one of the most dominant brands in the genre, with its latest video game instalment Resident Evil Requiem selling 8.5 million copies since its launch in February, and its latest big screen adaptation from Weapons director Zach Cregger quickly becoming the highest-grossing Resident Evil movie ever .
paragraphs.cn: 与此同时，恐怖题材在大多数娱乐媒介中的热度也处于少有的高位。独立恐怖电影《Backrooms》和《Obsession》在今年早些时候取得了巨大的票房成功，后者最终收入超过5亿美元。《生化危机》系列仍是该类型中最具统治力的品牌之一，其最新游戏《生化危机：安魂曲》自2月发售以来已售出850万份，而由《武器》导演扎克·克雷格执导的最新大银幕改编电影，也迅速成为有史以来票房最高的《生化危机》电影。

paragraphs.en: The surging popularity of spooks and scares has also spread to many popular streaming services. Mike Flanagan’s adaptation of Stephen King’s Carrie performing strong enough on Prime Video in order to be renewed for a second season . Friday the 13th prequel series Crystal Lake has apparently become one of Peacock’s biggest scripted original series. Meanwhile Apple’s Widows Bay is one of the most celebrated TV shows of the year – horror or otherwise – snaring a whopping 14 Emmy Awards in September.
paragraphs.cn: 惊悚恐怖内容日益高涨的人气也蔓延到了许多热门流媒体平台。迈克·弗拉纳根改编自斯蒂芬·金《Carrie》的作品在Prime Video上表现出色，得以续订第二季。《十三号星期五》前传剧集《Crystal Lake》显然已成为Peacock规模最大的原创剧本剧之一。与此同时，Apple的《Widows Bay》是今年最受赞誉的电视剧之一，无论恐怖题材还是其他题材都算在内，并于9月斩获多达14项艾美奖。

paragraphs.en: Even comic book movies are turning to the genre, with the DCU’s thoroughly disturbing Clayface enjoying a strong opening weekend in October . Public domain characters have also proved to be ripe for the picking, with two Winnie the Pooh slasher movies already released and a third one on the way in January .
paragraphs.cn: 就连漫画改编电影也在转向这一类型：DCU中令人极度不安的《Clayface》于10月取得了强劲的首周末票房。公共领域角色也被证明是可供选用的成熟素材，两部《小熊维尼》血腥砍杀电影已经上映，第三部也将在1月推出。

paragraphs.en: However, Bloober Team is no bandwagon-jumper. Although the foundational years of the studio were spent producing a mix of casual games and contract work, the developer has been singularly focussed on becoming a specialist house of horror since it launched Layers of Fear in 2016. In the decade since, Bloober has steadily risen to become one of the most trusted conjurers of fear and dread in videogames, proving to be equally adept at reimagining licensed properties as it is at establishing new IPs of its own.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，Bloober Team并不是跟风者。尽管工作室创立之初制作了各种休闲游戏，也承接了外包工作，但自2016年推出《层层恐惧》以来，这家开发商便一心专注于成为一家专攻恐怖题材的工作室。在此后的十年里，Bloober稳步崛起，成为游戏界最值得信赖的恐惧与惊骇营造者之一，证明了自己既擅长重新演绎获授权的作品，也擅长打造自己的全新IP。

paragraphs.en: “There are a lot of great horror game developers in the world; we are one of them,” said Babieno. “We’re trying to focus [purely] on creating horror so that’s why the iteration process allows us to work not just on the formula [for creating fear], but on the technological aspect of creating games.”
paragraphs.cn: Babieno说：「世界上有很多优秀的恐怖游戏开发商，我们是其中之一。我们试图专注于创作恐怖作品，因此迭代过程让我们不仅能够钻研营造恐惧的公式，还能钻研游戏制作的技术层面。」

paragraphs.en: “Also understanding our fans. Understanding what we did wrong and how we could improve. Project by project we are always thinking, ‘is this the next step for the studio? Is this the next step for our fans?’ Because if it’s not, you don’t want to waste four years of your life creating a new title.”
paragraphs.cn: 「还有理解我们的粉丝。了解我们做错了什么，以及我们可以如何改进。每做一个项目，我们总会思考：『这是工作室的下一步吗？这是为粉丝迈出的下一步吗？』因为如果不是，你不会想浪费人生中的四年去制作一款新作品。」

paragraphs.en: While Babieno’s team has become attuned to listening to its dedicated fanbase, it’s also learned to ignore its detractors online. Not unlike the undeserved backlash that Zach Cregger was forced to endure prior to the release of his Resident Evil movie , Bloober Team faced plenty of scrutiny from Silent Hill diehards when it was hard at work remaking Silent Hill 2. However, Babieno makes it clear that his team had complete confidence in their ability to reimagine the Konami classic to a standard that would be embraced by even its harshest of critics.
paragraphs.cn: Babieno的团队已经习惯了倾听忠实粉丝群体的声音，同时也学会了无视网上的诋毁者。扎克·克雷格在其《生化危机》电影上映前被迫承受了不应得的抵制，与此类似，Bloober Team在努力重制《寂静岭2》时，也受到了《寂静岭》死忠粉丝的大量审视。不过，Babieno明确表示，他的团队完全有信心重新演绎这部科乐美经典作品，使其达到连最严苛的批评者都会认可的水准。

paragraphs.en: “At the beginning we suffered a lot of hate from fans,” said Babieno. “But we did the one thing which any studio who is trying to create something great is able to do: focus on the project, focus on delivering the best quality game, and put the noise around it out of our head.”
paragraphs.cn: Babieno说：「一开始，我们遭到了粉丝的大量仇视。但我们做了任何试图创造伟大作品的工作室都能做到的一件事：专注于项目，专注于呈现质量最好的游戏，并把周围的杂音抛在脑后。」

paragraphs.en: “So this is what we tried to do; we believed from the very beginning that we’d be able to achieve this and it happened. Silent Hill 2 was a pivot point for Bloober Team.”
paragraphs.cn: 「所以这就是我们努力去做的事；我们从一开始就相信自己能够做到，而我们也确实做到了。《寂静岭2》是Bloober Team的一个转折点。」

paragraphs.en: Silent Hill 2’s subsequent critical and commercial success is likely a big part of the reason that Bloober Team now finds itself in such hot demand and experiencing a period of expansion at a time when so many other studios in the industry are suffering cuts and closures. Bloober Team is currently composed of two first-party studios, and has recently added the second-party Broken Mirror Games, a label that it uses to co-develop games with five other Polish development teams. A remake of the original Silent Hill, Layers of Fear 3, Nintendo Switch 2-exclusive Onyx: The Dark Grip, and Star Trek: Shadow Frontier, a psychological horror game set in Gene Roddenberry’s beloved sci-fi universe, are four of the seven games currently in development that have been confirmed so far.
paragraphs.cn: 《寂静岭2》随后在口碑和商业上取得的成功，很可能是在业内众多其他工作室遭遇裁员和关闭之际，Bloober Team如今却大受追捧并迎来扩张期的重要原因。Bloober Team目前由两家第一方工作室组成，最近又增设了第二方品牌Broken Mirror Games，并通过该品牌与另外五支波兰开发团队共同开发游戏。目前正在开发的七款游戏中，迄今已确认的四款分别是初代《寂静岭》重制版、《层层恐惧3》、Switch 2独占游戏《Onyx: The Dark Grip》，以及以吉恩·罗登贝瑞备受喜爱的科幻宇宙为背景的心理恐怖游戏《星际迷航：暗影边境》。

paragraphs.en: Babieno was unable to comment on the recent Silent Hill leak that suggested it would be released in 2027 and star Gabrielle Fritz and Jade Matthew – when prompted, he dismissed the details as "rumors." He also couldn’t reveal much about Star Trek: Shadow Frontier, other than agreeing with publishing partner Paramount Games Studio’s goals for it to be “the best Star Trek game of all time,” by stating simply that he wouldn’t be working on it if he “didn’t have such a fight.”
paragraphs.cn: Babieno无法就最近有关《寂静岭》的泄露消息发表评论，该消息称游戏将于2027年发售，并由Gabrielle Fritz和Jade Matthew主演。被问及时，他称这些细节只是「传言」。他也无法透露太多关于《星际迷航：暗影边境》的消息，只是认同发行合作伙伴Paramount Games Studio希望它成为「有史以来最好的《星际迷航》游戏」的目标，简单表示如果他「没有这种斗志」，就不会参与制作。

paragraphs.en: However, Babieno was keen to share his enthusiasm for Project H, the working title for the next game from the team behind 2025’s Cronos: The New Dawn. Although according to Babieno the project is only in the late stages of pre-production, he seems confident that it will represent yet another stride forward for the studio.
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Babieno很想分享自己对《Project H》的热情，这是2025年游戏《时间旅者：重生曙光》背后团队下一款游戏的暂定名。尽管据Babieno所说，该项目仅处于前期制作的后期阶段，但他似乎有信心，这将代表工作室再次向前迈出一大步。

paragraphs.en: “This project is like a huge step from Cronos and from our previous titles so it will deliver a new kind of experience,” said Babieno. “But at the same time it will be very familiar to everyone who [has] already played Bloober Team games. So we will still keep our DNA in it, but we will show this in a completely fresh new way.”
paragraphs.cn: Babieno说：「这个项目相较于《时间旅者：重生曙光》和我们以前的作品迈出了一大步，因此它将带来一种全新的体验。但与此同时，所有玩过Bloober Team游戏的人都会觉得它非常熟悉。所以我们仍会在其中保留我们的DNA，但会以一种焕然一新的方式呈现。」

paragraphs.en: Ultimately for Babieno, the ambition for Bloober Team and where it sits in the booming horror genre seems clear.
paragraphs.cn: 归根结底，对Babieno而言，Bloober Team的雄心以及它在蓬勃发展的恐怖类型中所处的位置似乎很明确。

paragraphs.en: “I love Silent Hill and Resident Evil, and I feel that there is a place for a third huge horror IP as well,” said Babieno. “I think we’re on the right track with everything we’re creating. You can feel that Bloober Team’s games are a little bit different [to] those that are already available on the market.”
paragraphs.cn: Babieno说：「我喜欢《寂静岭》和《生化危机》，我觉得市场也有第三个大型恐怖IP的一席之地。我认为我们正在创作的一切都走在正确的道路上。你能感觉到，Bloober Team的游戏与市场上已有的游戏有些不同。」

paragraphs.en: “The most important [goal] for me is to set new milestones in the game industry.”
paragraphs.cn: 「对我而言，最重要的目标是在游戏行业树立新的里程碑。」

paragraphs.en: Bloober Team’s next release is DLC for Cronos: The New Dawn. Dubbed Cronos: Lazarus, this story expansion serves as a prequel to the events of the main game and will apparently present players with a “faster, more aggressive style of combat.” Cronos: Lazarus is set to release on December 3 for PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and PC, with the Nintendo Switch 2 version launching sometime in early 2027.
paragraphs.cn: Bloober Team接下来推出的是《时间旅者：重生曙光》的DLC。这款名为《Cronos: Lazarus》的剧情扩展内容是游戏本篇事件的前传，显然将为玩家带来「更快、更具侵略性的战斗风格」。《Cronos: Lazarus》定于12月3日在PS5、XBOX Series和PC平台发售，Switch 2版本将在2027年初的某个时候推出。
